response.sql: WITH media_stats AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM MediaType AS mt JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_rate FROM media_stats) SELECT AVG(ms.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(ms.bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(ms.bytes_per_millisecond - b.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_above_average FROM media_stats AS ms CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE ms.bytes_per_millisecond > b.avg_rate;
